title: Slow Cooker Birria
text:
A hearty and flavorful Mexican stew that's perfect for a cozy night in. This dish features tender, slow-cooked beef (or goat) that's simmered in a rich, spicy broth made with dried chiles, spices, and citrus.
The meat is typically served in tacos, quesadillas, or simply as a stew with warm tortillas. The broth, often referred to as "consommé," is a delicious dipping sauce for the tacos.
ingredients:
2 Onions
10 Cloves Garlic
20g Avacado Oil (~1.5 tablespoons)
10 guajillo chiles(De-stemmed & de-seeded)
3 ancho chiles (De-stemmed & de-seeded)
32oz beef bone broth (896ml)
1 cup of water
1 tablespoon coarse salt
1 tablespoon ground cumin
1 tablespoon dried oregano
1 tablespoon black pepper
1 teaspoon paprika
90ml apple cider vinegar (6 tblspns)
240ml red enchilada sauce (~1 cup)
Handful of cilantro stems
64oz top sirloin, trimmed of all exterior fat (can also use London broil, flank steak, or any other lean cut of steak)
Salt
3 bay leaves

Step1: Cook in a Pot-

Step4: Throw everything into blender
Step5: Add into Blender-
• 1 tablespoon coarse salt

• 1 tablespoon dried oregano
• 1 tablespoon black pepper
• 1 teaspoon paprika
• 90ml apple cider vinegar (6 tblspns)
• 240ml red enchilada sauce (~1 cup)
•Handful of cilantro stems
Step6: Toss into Slow Cooker-
• 64oz top sirloin, trimmed of all exterior fat (can also use London broil, flank steak, or any other lean cut of steak)
• salt every steak
• 3 bay leaves
Step7: Slowcook for 7-8hrs. on Low
